using Power Point
Presentation
suggestions.after:
- Guided lecture-discussion with a Power Point presentation on FIR and IIR filters, types of DSP, microprocessor and signal processor architecture, integrators, companding, bandwidth restrictions, sensors and transducers, followed by a short quiz-style recap
- Visual and collaborative: in pairs, build a comparison table of FIR and IIR advantages and disadvantages, then justify to the class which filter suits a sensor or transducer signal-conditioning example

- Reflective: write a short journal entry or concept map linking the nature, components and fundamental concepts of DSP to its applications, explaining why each matters
suggestions.why: Replaced the single lecture with a lecture plus several alternative activities (collaborative, hands-on/self-paced, reflective) in which students practise comparing and justifying FIR vs IIR and relating DSP concepts to applications, still on the week's content, so the quiz task still fits.
